what_matters.head: Micron beat its own forecast on every line and put this quarter's revenue at $61.5B, above the $57.0B analysts expected.
what_matters.detail: Shares rose 0.4% after hours to $1,069; the regular close was unchanged. Figures under Earnings.

what_matters.head: Cerebras fell 8.9% on twice its usual volume after a report that OpenAI's newest fast tier runs on Nvidia GPUs.
what_matters.detail: SemiAnalysis said on X that GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast, unveiled at OpenAI's DevDay on 29 Sep, runs on Nvidia GPUs; the earlier Ultrafast tier ran on Cerebras chips. Cerebras had not commented in the articles found.

what_matters.head: September payrolls come out Friday at 20:30 SGT, the only high-impact release in the 7-day calendar.
what_matters.detail: After that: September CPI on 14 Oct, and the Fed's rate decision on 29 Oct at 02:00 SGT.

after_data.text: September exports rose 83.5% from a year earlier to a record $120.9B, above the 62% expected. The KOSPI then closed 1.95% higher, with SK Hynix up 3.21% and Samsung up 2.79% at the close, about double their 12:05 SGT part-day gains. Not in Wednesday's US prices.

At 05:16 New York time Thursday (17:16 SGT) the 10-year yield had reached 5.32% and the 30-year 5.66%, both the highest since 2002. Dow futures were down 0.5% and Nasdaq 100 futures up 0.3%; Micron was about 1% lower before the open. Not in Wednesday's US prices.
Google launched Gemini 4 Argon, its most advanced AI model, on Wednesday; Alphabet rose about 2% after hours and 2.3% in Thursday's premarket. Its +1.0% Wednesday close is in the data.
Japan's finance ministry reported no yen intervention from 27 Aug to 28 Sep (released 30 Sep in Tokyo, before Wednesday's US close).

No announcement by 30 Sep of Cerebras CS-4 shipments, Palantir's Maven program of record or the Mitsubishi Electric / ROHM / Toshiba power-chip plan (company, SEC and DoD sites checked 1 Oct). Nvidia has not posted its results date.
Jiji reports the three now aim to agree by their November results, and a dispute over the deal's form could push it to March 2027 (unverified: Jiji Press, 1 Oct).

This version adds Korea's full-day close, Japan's yen release, Thursday's US premarket and Alphabet's model launch; the morning version's facts are unchanged.

out.text: Fiscal Q4 (to 3 Sep): revenue $54.23B vs the company's $49–51B forecast and $51.07B analysts expected (LSEG); earnings per share $33.42 vs $31.61 expected; gross margin 87.0%; free cash flow $33.2B. This quarter's forecast: revenue $61.5B ± $1.5B ($57.02B expected), earnings per share $38.15 ± $1.00 ($35.40 expected), gross margin about 86.25%. From the prepared remarks: most of 2027's HBM supply is contracted at significantly higher prices, and multi-year customer agreements rose to 26 from 16 a quarter ago.

coming.facts: The company's forecast: revenue €11.0–12.0B at a 55–57% gross margin. Options trading implies a move of about ±8.3% either way by 16 Oct (as of the 30 Sep close); its last four results averaged +2.19% / -1.22% (the report's historical band). Analysts' figures are in euros and are not quoted.

earnings.note: Micron's analysts' figures: LSEG, via Reuters. TSMC reports 15 Oct (time not in the data); its forecast is $44.6–45.8B revenue at a 65–67% gross margin, options trading implies a move of about ±6.0% either way by 16 Oct (as of the 30 Sep close), and its September sales come 8 Oct.
